title: Lena and the Border
author: Rosalind Okonkwo
blurb: August Hartwell, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must extract a defector who may be the bait before the summit convenes.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
